text.tspan: Reactor variant (RequestLoggingWebFilter); the coroutine variant follows the identical flow
correlation id (header | generated), echo on response
log() on the exchange logger; events counter
CoRequestLoggingWebFilter: identical flow and the same ExchangeLifecycle;
signals come from try/catch (CancellationException -> CANCEL, Throwable -> ERROR,
both rethrown) and the chain runs inside withContext(MDCContext(ambient + identity)).
WARN breadcrumb on the module logger
open on the gauge - the liveness
Fail-open everywhere: every host call (MDC adapter, appender, MeterRegistry,
response facade) is guarded. A failure is counted on endpoint.logging.failopen
(stage = wiring | arrival | emission), reported on the module's own logger, and
never reaches the request. Emission and gauge-close are exactly-once.
